import cv2, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png')
hsv=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
# duck candidate
x0,y0,x1,y1=2650,650,3220,1050
h=hsv[y0:y1,x0:x1]
s=h[...,1]; v=h[...,2]; hue=h[...,0]
# saturation/color mask, includes yellow/orange but not beige
m=((s>72)&(v>70)&(hue>=4)&(hue<=42)).astype(np.uint8)*255
# close then fill holes within largest contour
m=cv2.morphologyEx(m,cv2.MORPH_CLOSE,np.ones((9,9),np.uint8))
contours,_=cv2.findContours(m,cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL,cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
# select contour near center, combine all large
keep=np.zeros_like(m)
for c in contours:
 if cv2.contourArea(c)>100:
  cv2.drawContours(keep,[c],-1,255,-1)
# fill internal holes in bbox by floodfill
ff=keep.copy(); hh,ww=ff.shape; mask=np.zeros((hh+2,ww+2),np.uint8); cv2.floodFill(ff,mask,(0,0),255)
holes=cv2.bitwise_not(ff)
keep=cv2.bitwise_or(keep,holes)
# only actual duck region bounding rect? holes from contour not background
# smooth 2px
a=cv2.GaussianBlur(keep,(0,0),1.2)
rgba=np.dstack([im[y0:y1,x0:x1],a])
# crop preview alpha composited magenta
preview=im[y0:y1,x0:x1].copy(); preview[a<128]=(255,0,255)
Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(np.hstack([im[y0:y1,x0:x1],preview, np.dstack([a,a,a])]),cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)).save('.tmp_duckmask.png')
print('mask bbox',cv2.boundingRect(keep), 'area',np.count_nonzero(keep))
# inpaint duck broad mask: derive bbox, add shadow region below
mask_full=np.zeros(im.shape[:2],np.uint8)
# based on alpha > 4, dilate 8
mask_full[y0:y1,x0:x1]=((a>4)*255).astype(np.uint8)
mask_full=cv2.dilate(mask_full,np.ones((15,15),np.uint8))
# shadow rectangle around duck lower, but avoid body? we need remove existing shadow as well
cv2.ellipse(mask_full,(2900,954),(250,65),0,0,360,255,-1)
plate=cv2.inpaint(im,mask_full,7,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(plate[600:1120,2550:3300],cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)).save('.tmp_duckplate.png')
PY"
